skill_name: Develop ideas for a new customer loyalty program
workflow:
We propose a customer loyalty program which rewards customers with points for referrals and purchases. Customers can earn points for referring new customers, or for purchasing certain products or services. These points can then be redeemed for discounts or rewards.

The program could also include additional incentives such as exclusive access to upcoming products, special promotional deals, or early access to sales. We can also offer additional incentives for customers who reach certain mileston
